title: Resonance and Damping
idiom: Futurist-like charcoal motion study, a swing's arcs narrowing as it comes to rest
hero_prompt: Charcoal drawing in the manner of a Futurist motion study, soft black charcoal with one wash of warm ochre on pale grey-white paper, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible charcoal smudge and paper grain, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, wide panoramic composition: a plain wooden swing hangs on two ropes from a high crossbar, a small child sitting on it with legs out; behind the swing its earlier positions are drawn as faint repeated outlines of the seat and ropes, fanning in a wide arc at first, each one a little narrower, closing toward the seat hanging straight down; a man stands to one side with his arms lowered, having just stopped pushing, watching it come to rest. Evening light, long empty ground, plenty of pale paper.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on an ochre ground, no shading or gradients: a swing seat hanging on two straight ropes from a crossbar, and below it three thick nested curved arcs, the outermost the widest. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
